facts.text: FeatureIdentificationDevice is the basic implementation of the Wasatch FID spectrometer USB API defined in ENG-0001
get_integration_time_ms reads GET_INTEGRATION_TIME_MS and returns the value in milliseconds
set_integration_time_ms rounds to an integer millisecond value, sends SET_INTEGRATION_TIME_MS (0xB2) and stores the session value
The minimum and maximum integration time are EEPROM fields of each unit, not constants of the class
get_spectrum returns the acquired pixel intensities as response.data
The wavelength axis is generated from the EEPROM wavelength calibration coefficients
get_laser_enabled reports the laser enable state
set_laser_enable turns the laser on or off and false turns it off
The laser_enable setting is documented as turning the laser on or off
get_detector_temperature_degC converts the detector temperature reading to degrees Celsius
get_detector_tec_setpoint_degC reports the applied detector TEC set point in degrees Celsius
get_tec_enabled reads the detector TEC enable state
get_ambient_temperature_degC reports the ambient temperature on XS and Gen 1.5 spectrometers
disconnect disables the laser if it was enabled and releases the interface
